explication: Code - OSS is the open-source codebase for Visual Studio Code, a developer editor for the edit-build-debug cycle. A developer uses the editor for code editing, navigation, and understanding, with lightweight debugging and extensibility; bundled language extensions add richer language support. The graph also preserves documented product branches and prominent indexed subsystems, including agent hosting, search, authentication, GitHub queries, edit-session storage, Markdown preview, and Copilot. Relationships are limited to README statements and SOURCE INDEX references; unsampled subsystems are shown without guessed call flows.
